title: Frontend: Capitalize Words
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Capitalize Words. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(text). For each whitespace-delimited token, uppercase its first Unicode code point and preserve the remainder and all original whitespace.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Choose whether the rest of each word is preserved or lowercased, then implement exactly that rule.
alternativeApproaches: Preserve whitespace exactly using token-aware replacement rather than split-and-join.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Multiple spaces; empty text; apostrophes.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
